Hi Jordan and Marissa,

Thanks for the heads-up. We can hold two adjacent accessible rooms on the same corridor (ADA King + ADA Queen) and will mark them as adjacency requested in our manifest. There is no incremental rate for adjacency itself, but late arrivals after midnight incur a one-time late-processing fee of $25 per group to cover front-desk staffing — that fee can be placed on the master bill or charged to cards on file.

For unattended keydrop, we use a secure keysafe and pre-printed registration forms. Procedure we recommend:
- Guest names & CC authorization collected in advance and submitted to our reservations team.
- Two designated staff will verify IDs upon arrival; if after midnight, the keysafe code is provided via secure SMS to the designated on-site host.
- We will supply a PDF of the Accessible Room List and the pre-printed registration template for your review (attached).

Attachments: Accessible_Room_List.pdf (list and room numbers reserved), late_checkin_template.pdf (registration template)

Emily Hart
Senior Events Manager — Hilton Downtown
Attachments: Accessible_Room_List.pdf, late_checkin_template.pdf
